runs.final_sql:
SELECT unit_msr.nm
FROM bom
JOIN unit_msr ON bom.ref1 = unit_msr.unt_msr_cd
WHERE bom.ref2 = 494
  AND bom.end_dt IS NULL
SELECT pv.avrg_ld_tm, v.nm FROM prod_vnd pv JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1 WHERE v.ref1 = 1496

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN addr.cty = 'Bothell' THEN cust.cstm_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN addr.cty = 'Kenmore' THEN cust.cstm_id END)) AS diff, st_prv.nm FROM cust JOIN biz_addr ON cust.ref3 = biz_addr.ref1 OR cust.ref1 = biz_addr.ref1 JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id WHERE addr.cty IN ('Bothell', 'Kenmore') GROUP BY st_prv.nm
SELECT prod_vnd.stnd_prc FROM prod_vnd JOIN prod ON prod_vnd.ref3 = prod.prdc_id WHERE prod.nm = 'Hex Nut 5'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ref1) AS cnt
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE p.eml_prmt = 0 AND d.nm = 'Engineering'

WITH latest_pay AS (
  SELECT ref1, rt
  FROM (
    SELECT ref1, rt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_pay_hist
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
prod_tech AS (
  SELECT e.ref1, lp.rt
  FROM emp e
  JOIN latest_pay lp ON e.ref1 = lp.ref1
  WHERE e.jb_ttl = 'Production Technician'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS below_avg_count
FROM prod_tech
WHERE rt < (SELECT AVG(rt) FROM prod_tech)

SELECT s.strt_tm, s.end_tm
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN shft s ON edh.ref1 = s.shft_id
WHERE YEAR(e.brth_dt) < 1969
  AND e.ref1 = (
    SELECT ref1
    FROM emp
    WHERE YEAR(brth_dt) < 1969
    ORDER BY brth_dt ASC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 5
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ref1)
FROM prsn p
JOIN prsn_crd pc ON pc.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN crd c ON c.crdt_crd_id = pc.ref2
WHERE p.prsn_typ = 'SC'
  AND c.crd_typ = 'Vista'

SELECT d.nm AS department_name, AVG(YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(e.brth_dt)) AS average_age
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY average_age ASC

SELECT AVG(YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(e.hr_dt)) AS average_length_of_employment
FROM emp e
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Research and Development' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT SUM(pd.ordr_qty) / COUNT(sh.shp_mthd_id) AS average_ordered_quantity
FROM po_dtl pd
JOIN po_hdr ph ON pd.ref2 = ph.prch_ordr_id
JOIN shp_mth sh ON ph.ref1 = sh.shp_mthd_id
WHERE sh.nm = 'CARGO TRANSPORT 5'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref2)
FROM prsn p
JOIN emp e ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref1 = e.ref1
WHERE p.frst_nm = 'Sheela' AND p.lst_nm = 'Word'
AND edh.strt_dt <= '2012-12-31'
AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR edh.end_dt >= '2011-01-01')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dept.dprt_id)
FROM prsn
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp_dept_hist.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN dept ON dept.dprt_id = emp_dept_hist.ref2
WHERE prsn.frst_nm = 'David' AND prsn.lst_nm = 'Bradley'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref3)
FROM emp_dept_hist edh
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN shft s ON s.shft_id = edh.ref1
WHERE d.nm = 'Information Services'
  AND s.nm = 'Evening'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref3) FROM emp_dept_hist edh JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id WHERE d.nm = 'Engineering' AND edh.strt_dt <= '2009-12-31' AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR edh.end_dt >= '2009-01-01')

SELECT ((MAX(p.lst_prc) - MIN(p.lst_prc)) / MIN(p.lst_prc)) * 100 AS percentage_more_expensive
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Clothing'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref2) AS product_count FROM so_dtl WHERE ordr_qty > 2 AND unt_prc_dscn > 0

SELECT p.nm
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_vnd pv ON pv.ref3 = p.prdc_id
WHERE pv.mn_ordr_qty = 1000
  AND p.stnd_cst > 17
GROUP BY p.prdc_id, p.nm

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, e.hr_dt
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM emp_dept_hist edh
  WHERE edh.ref1 = e.ref1
    AND edh.end_dt IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm, 2022 - YEAR(emp.brth_dt) + 1 AS age
FROM emp
JOIN prsn ON emp.ref1 = prsn.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist ON emp.ref1 = emp_dept_hist.ref3
WHERE emp_dept_hist.ref1 = 3 AND emp_dept_hist.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY emp.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm FROM prsn p JOIN emp e ON p.ref1 = e.ref1 JOIN emp_pay_hist eph ON e.ref1 = eph.ref1 WHERE e.mrtl_stts = 'M' ORDER BY eph.rt DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT d.nm
FROM prsn p
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON edh.ref3 = p.ref1
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE p.frst_nm = 'David' AND p.lst_nm = 'Bradley' AND edh.end_dt IS NOT NULL
SELECT vnd.nm FROM prod JOIN prod_vnd ON prod.prdc_id = prod_vnd.ref2 JOIN vnd ON vnd.ref1 = prod_vnd.ref3 WHERE prod.prdc_nmbr = 'WB-H098'

WITH eng_emp AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT edh.ref1 AS emp_id
    FROM emp_dept_hist edh
    JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
    WHERE d.nm = 'Engineering'
      AND YEAR(edh.strt_dt) <= 2007
      AND (edh.end_dt IS NULL OR YEAR(edh.end_dt) >= 2007)
),
latest_pay AS (
    SELECT ref1 AS emp_id, rt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref1 ORDER BY rt_chng_dt DESC) AS rn
    FROM emp_pay_hist
)
SELECT AVG(lp.rt) AS average_pay_rate
FROM eng_emp e
JOIN latest_pay lp ON e.emp_id = lp.emp_id AND lp.rn = 1
SELECT wo.stck_qty FROM wo JOIN wo_rtg ON wo.wrk_ordr_id = wo_rtg.ref2 WHERE wo_rtg.ref1 = 40 GROUP BY wo.wrk_ordr_id, wo.stck_qty

SELECT edh.end_dt
FROM emp AS e
JOIN emp_dept_hist AS edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept AS d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE e.jb_ttl = 'Senior Tool Designer'
  AND YEAR(e.hr_dt) - YEAR(e.brth_dt) = 33
  AND d.nm = 'Engineering'
  AND edh.end_dt IS NOT NULL

SELECT addr.addr_ln1, addr.addr_ln2, addr.cty, st_prv.nm, addr.pstl_cd
FROM prsn
JOIN biz_addr ON prsn.ref1 = biz_addr.ref1
JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id
JOIN addr_typ ON biz_addr.ref2 = addr_typ.addr_typ_id
JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id
WHERE prsn.ref1 = 5555 AND addr_typ.nm = 'Home'

SELECT DISTINCT pm.nm
FROM prod_mdl pm
JOIN pmdc p1 ON p1.ref3 = pm.prdc_mdl_id
JOIN prod_dsc d1 ON d1.prdc_dscr_id = p1.ref2
JOIN pmdc p2 ON p2.ref3 = pm.prdc_mdl_id
JOIN prod_dsc d2 ON d2.prdc_dscr_id = p2.ref2
JOIN cult c ON c.cltr_id = p2.ref1
WHERE d1.dscr = 'Chromoly steel'
  AND d2.dscr = 'AdventureWorks'
  AND c.nm = 'English'

SELECT d.nm
FROM dept d
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
JOIN shft s ON edh.ref1 = s.shft_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Night'
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.nm
FROM emp_dept_hist edh
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN shft s ON edh.ref3 = s.shft_id
WHERE s.nm = 'Evening' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM emp_dept_hist edh
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
JOIN emp e ON edh.ref3 = e.ref1
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
WHERE d.nm = 'Engineering' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY edh.strt_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT v.nm
FROM prod_vnd pv
JOIN prod p ON pv.ref3 = p.prdc_id
JOIN vnd v ON pv.ref2 = v.ref1
WHERE p.nm = 'Hex Nut 5'
ORDER BY pv.stnd_prc ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm FROM stor JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2 JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref2 = prsn.ref1 WHERE stor.nm = 'Next-Door Bike Store'

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_pay_hist h ON e.ref1 = h.ref1
WHERE e.gndr = 'F' AND e.mrtl_stts = 'S'
ORDER BY h.rt DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Shipping and Receiving' AND YEAR(e.hr_dt) = 2009
GROUP BY e.ref1, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm

SELECT stor.nm, prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id
JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref2 = prsn.ref1
WHERE sls_terr.nm = 'France'

SELECT prsn.frst_nm, prsn.lst_nm, sls_terr.nm
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref1
JOIN prsn ON prsn.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref1
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_terr.trrt_id = sls_prsn.ref2
WHERE stor.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT prod_vnd.avrg_ld_tm, (prod_vnd.lst_rcpt_cst - prod_vnd.stnd_prc) AS profit_on_net, addr.addr_ln1, addr.addr_ln2, addr.cty, addr.pstl_cd FROM prod_vnd JOIN vnd ON prod_vnd.ref2 = vnd.ref1 JOIN biz_addr ON vnd.ref1 = biz_addr.ref1 JOIN addr ON biz_addr.ref3 = addr.addr_id WHERE prod_vnd.ref3 = 843

SELECT d.nm, AVG(eph.rt) AS avg_hourly_payrate
FROM (
    SELECT e1.ref1, e1.rt
    FROM emp_pay_hist e1
    JOIN (
        SELECT ref1, MAX(rt_chng_dt) AS max_dt
        FROM emp_pay_hist
        GROUP BY ref1
    ) e2 ON e1.ref1 = e2.ref1 AND e1.rt_chng_dt = e2.max_dt
) eph
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON eph.ref1 = edh.ref3
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm

WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = b.ref3
  WHERE p.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'
    AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, bt.lvl + 1 AS lvl
  FROM bom_tree bt
  JOIN bom b ON b.ref3 = bt.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.nm AS component_name, bt.lvl AS level
FROM bom_tree bt
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = bt.component_id
ORDER BY bt.lvl, p.nm

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cstm_id)
FROM cust c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM prsn_crd pc
    WHERE pc.ref1 = c.ref1
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM so_hdr so
    WHERE so.ref8 = c.cstm_id
      AND so.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01'
      AND so.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
)

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
FROM cust c
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = c.ref3
JOIN so_hdr soh ON soh.ref1 = c.cstm_id
WHERE c.ref3 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.cstm_id, p.ref1, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
ORDER BY SUM(soh.ttl_due) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sh.sls_ordr_id)
FROM so_hdr sh
JOIN cust c ON sh.ref8 = c.cstm_id
WHERE YEAR(sh.ordr_dt) = 2013
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM biz_addr ba
    JOIN addr a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id
    JOIN st_prv sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id
    JOIN cnty co ON sp.ref2 = co.cntr_rgn_cd
    WHERE ba.ref1 = COALESCE(c.ref3, c.ref1)
      AND co.nm = 'Canada'
  )

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, COUNT(so.sls_ordr_id) AS order_count
FROM sls_prsn sp
JOIN prsn p ON sp.ref1 = p.ref1
LEFT JOIN so_hdr so ON sp.ref1 = so.ref7 AND so.ordr_dt >= '2013-01-01' AND so.ordr_dt < '2014-01-01'
GROUP BY sp.ref1, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
ORDER BY order_count

SELECT d.nm AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT edh.ref1) AS headcount
FROM emp_dept_hist edh
JOIN dept d ON d.dprt_id = edh.ref2
WHERE edh.end_dt IS NULL
GROUP BY d.dprt_id, d.nm
ORDER BY headcount

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT h.ref2) AS dept_count
FROM emp_dept_hist h
JOIN prsn p ON p.ref1 = h.ref1
GROUP BY p.ref1, p.frst_nm, p.lst_nm
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.ref2) > 1

SELECT v.nm, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.ref3) AS product_count
FROM vnd v
JOIN prod_vnd pv ON v.ref1 = pv.ref2
GROUP BY v.ref1, v.nm
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT v.nm, COUNT(po.prch_ordr_id) AS purchase_order_count
FROM po_hdr po
JOIN vnd v ON po.ref2 = v.ref1
GROUP BY v.ref1, v.nm
ORDER BY purchase_order_count DESC

SELECT p.frst_nm, p.mddl_nm, p.lst_nm, e.jb_ttl
FROM emp e
JOIN prsn p ON e.ref1 = p.ref1
JOIN emp_dept_hist edh ON e.ref1 = edh.ref1
JOIN dept d ON edh.ref2 = d.dprt_id
WHERE d.nm = 'Sales' AND edh.end_dt IS NULL
ORDER BY p.lst_nm

SELECT s.nm, a.cty, sp.nm
FROM stor s
JOIN biz_addr ba ON s.ref2 = ba.ref1
JOIN addr a ON ba.ref3 = a.addr_id
JOIN st_prv sp ON a.ref1 = sp.stt_prvn_id
ORDER BY s.nm
